mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may reduce renal clearance of amantadine, potentially increasing amantadine plasma concentrations and CNS adverse effects, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely; consider amantadine dose reduction if creatinine clearance is <60 mL/min; assess for amantadine toxicity (tremor, confusion, hallucinations).
